repos_data.description: NobodyWho is an inference engine that lets you run LLMs locally and efficiently on any device.

Verified knowledge for AI agents.  Compress context, extract and store facts, define rules, and ask questions — get deterministic answers with proof, not LLM guesses. Connect agents via MCP, Python SDK, TypeSc

Qwen3.8-27B on one laptop CPU: up to 2.52 token/s, 8 GB tested, with no accuracy loss from runtime speedups. Native C, no GPU or Python. | 单颗笔记本 CPU 运行 Qwen3.8-27B：最快 2.52 token/s，最低 8 GB 内存可运行；推理加速不牺牲准确性。原生 C 语言，无需 GPU 或 Python。
